description: MediaMath MathTag pixels on pixel.mathtag.com/event/js and /event/img. MediaMath documents mt_id and mt_adid on the JS pixel. sync.mathtag.com cookie sync is not contracted. Mobile /event/mob is not contracted.

params.name: mt_id
params.description: It is the TerminalOne Pixel ID. MediaMath documents it as the value from mt_id on a JS pixel from a website.
params.fix_hint: Copy the MathTag from TerminalOne so mt_id carries the Pixel ID.

params.name: mt_adid
params.description: It is the TerminalOne Advertiser ID. MediaMath documents it as the value from mt_adid on a JS pixel from a website.
params.fix_hint: Copy the MathTag from TerminalOne so mt_adid carries the Advertiser ID.

params.name: mt_exem
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hashed email for MediaMath ConnectedID. MediaMath documents that hashing is not performed by the pixel; raw email must not be sent.
params.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send the hex digest as mt_exem.

params.name: mt_excl
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hashed account ID for MediaMath ConnectedID.
params.fix_hint: Hash the account ID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest as mt_excl.

rules.message: A parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. MediaMath documents mt_exem as a SHA-256 digest and says personally identifiable information must not be sent.
rules.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send it as mt_exem.
